Title: Verify OrangeHRM login page loads correctly
Preconditions: User has access to the application URL.
Expected Result: The OrangeHRM login page is displayed with Username and Password fields and a Login button.

Title: Verify Username and Password fields are editable
Preconditions: User is on the OrangeHRM login page.
Steps: Navigate to the OrangeHRM login page.

Title: Verify Username and Password fields are editable
Preconditions: User is on the OrangeHRM login page.
Steps: Enter the username '$HRM_USERNAME' in the Username field.

Title: Verify Username and Password fields are editable
Preconditions: User is on the OrangeHRM login page.
Steps: Enter the password '$HRM_PASSWORD' in the Password field.
Expected Result: The Username field accepts input '$HRM_USERNAME'. The Password field accepts input and masks the characters.

Preconditions: User is on the OrangeHRM login page.
Expected Result: The password characters are masked (not shown in plain text) while being entered.
